headline: 剪輯電影：情懷還是圈錢
context: 在 YouTube 和串流平台隨手可得同類內容的今天，《Jackass》、《鬼滅之刃》、Peppa Pig 等作品的「舊素材剪輯版」電影，帶來了情懷還是只是在吃老本，值得思量。另有一部喜劇恐怖片《Hold the Fort》簡潔好看，以及 2026 年世足盃期間紐約高線公園下方的足球文化快閃展。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: While movie mixtapes served a purpose in the pre-video era, Jackass, Demon Slayer, Peppa Pig and other theatrically released assemblages of old material risk looking like cynical cash grabs today Johnny Knoxville has declared that the fifth Jackass movie, Best and Last, will mark the end of the franchise, and the trailer suggests a victory lap celebrating 25 years of broken bones, injured genitals and general stupidity you shouldn’t try at home. There are new stunts, and conversations with the cast about growing old gracelessly as they enter their 50s, but the most striking thing is how much archive footage there is. And the cast have not been hiding in interviews that it will be heavy on scenes from prior movies. In other words, it’s the cinematic equivalent of a greatest hits album that has a couple of new songs tossed on to entice fans to part with their money. Or a clip show episode of a US sitcom which is based on flashbacks to older episodes, created so that overworked writers can reach their network-mandated episode count. But in the age of YouTube and streaming, when you can watch many a fan-edited Jackass compilation featuring the same footage, it is asking a lot of audiences to leave their homes and part with their money to see it. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: A couple move from the city to a seemingly clean-cut suburb in this enjoyable comedy-horror that breezes through the grisly deaths of characters you won’t care about In this short, sharp, comedy-horror-siege movie, youngish couple Jenny (Haley Leary) and Lucas (Chris Mayers) are the newcomers in a clean-cut – or is it? – suburban neighbourhood, having moved away from the big city. Lucas is a world-class red-flag-ignorer, while in contrast, Jenny is adept at spotting the signs that something is off. When the perky moustachioed head of the local homeowners’ association Jerry (Julian Smith) invites the pair to a party celebrating the equinox, he assures them “it’s to DIE for!” in the tone of voice Ned Flanders might use in a Simpsons Halloween special. Jenny immediately asks the reasonable question: “Why would you say it like that?” Roles are soon reversed at said homeowners’ association party, as an ample helping of the local moonshine blunts Jenny’s natural caution, leaving Lucas to notice that they seem to be in the early stages of a wacky horror film. Hold the Fort jumps pretty much straight into the action, with straightforwardly drawn characters essentially replacing elaborate backstory or scene setting, allowing the film to clock in at a lean 75 minutes – if you’re in the market for a movie you can start watching at 9pm and still get an early night, that’s certainly a point in its favour. On the downside, the breezily sketched characters don’t have the time to earn a place in anyone’s heart, making for a sense of weightlessness; it doesn’t feel like anything happening here massively matters, even if the ensemble cast scream in shock and surprise and meet grisly deaths on a fairly regular basis. 🧵 1/N
📌 八大藝術

剪輯電影：情懷還是圈錢

強尼・諾克斯維爾（Johnny Knoxville）宣告《Jackass》第五集是最後一集，但預告片裡舊素材一片連一片，讓人不禁想問：這是向 25 年傳奇致敬，還是在吃老本？在 YouTube 和串流當道的今天，舊剪輯一鍵可得，要觀眾掏錢進戲院看，門檻真的高了不少。喜劇恐怖片《Hold the Fort》輕鬆好看，只是 75 分鐘內角色沒能真正走進你心裡。世足盃期間，紐約高線公園下方出現足球文化快閃展，比利（Pelé）1958 年的世界盃球衣就靜靜地陳列其中。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian 與 Dezeen，2026 年 6 月 24 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
強尼・諾克斯維爾（Johnny Knoxville）宣告《Jackass》第五集《Best and Last》是系列終章，預告片確實有新特技，也有對衰老的真實感慨。但最突出的，還是大量舊素材的重複使用。在 YouTube 和串流平台隨手可得同類內容的今天，說服觀眾走出家門買票，是愈來愈難的事。《Demon Slayer》《Peppa Pig》等作品的劇場版舊素材合集，也面對同樣質疑。喜劇恐怖片《Hold the Fort》75 分鐘輕鬆好看，角色深度稍欠。世足盃期間，紐約高線公園下方出現足球文化快閃展，比利（Pelé）1958 年世界盃球衣是鎮館之寶。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 Dezeen 於 2026 年 6 月 24 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 強尼・諾克斯維爾宣告《Jackass》第五集是系列終章，但預告片裡舊素材一片接一片。在 YouTube 和串流隨手可得的今天，要觀眾掏錢進戲院看剪輯合集，難度確實不小。《Demon Slayer》《Peppa Pig》的劇場版舊素材合集也面臨同樣質疑——這是情懷，還是在吃老本，觀眾心裡有數。另外，喜劇恐怖片《Hold the Fort》輕鬆好看，七十五分鐘，只是角色沒能真正走進心裡。世足盃期間，紐約高線公園下方出現了一個足球文化快閃展，比利一九五八年的世界盃球衣就靜靜陳列在那裡。
